evidence_basis.title: Short-Term Return Predictability and Repetitive Institutional Net Order Activity
evidence_basis.authors: Dermot P. Murphy and Ramabhadran S. Thirumalai
evidence_basis.claim_used: Half-hour returns and repetitive institutional order activity predict same-half-hour returns on subsequent days.

evidence_basis.title: Intraday Patterns in the Cross-section of Stock Returns
evidence_basis.authors: Steven L. Heston, Robert A. Korajczyk, and Ronnie Sadka
evidence_basis.claim_used: Cross-sectional half-hour return continuation appears at exact daily multiples and persists for as long as 40 sessions.

causal_boundaries: prediction is frozen one minute before the half-hour entry slot
current-slot bars are forbidden from every predictor
historical same-slot inputs end at the prior completed session
current-session context ends before the predicted slot
cross-sectional features exclude the candidate and require at least 30 peers
unfilled and unresolved calls remain in the issued-call ledger
top-k views do not expand the 12-specification trial budget
evidence_boundary: Published results justify testing SSM but do not prove an OHLCV-only current-NSE edge. All existing 120-session history is consumed development evidence and cannot establish a new baseline.

decision.reason: Milestone 0 freezes the published SSM hypothesis and its rejection gates before implementation or evaluation. It contains no performance result.
